# A package that does not check: every query prints the errors and exits 1.
# A package directory that does not exist gives an error with no file. A
# usage error exits 2.
> def run
# exit 1
# stderr
error src/main.nra:2:22: expected int, found string
> --json def run
# exit 1
{"errors": [{"code": "E0000", "severity": "error", "message": "expected int, found string", "file": "src/main.nra", "range": {"start": [2, 22], "end": [2, 22]}, "fixes": []}]}
> type-of src/main.nra:2:9
# exit 1
# stderr
error src/main.nra:2:22: expected int, found string
> --package missing def run
# exit 1
# stderr
error stat missing: no such file or directory
> --json --package missing def run
# exit 1
{"errors": [{"code": "E0000", "severity": "error", "message": "stat missing: no such file or directory", "fixes": []}]}
> unknown run
# exit 2
# stderr
usage: narrac query [--package DIR] [--json] type-of FILE:LINE:COL | def NAME | refs NAME | callers FUNCTION | interface MODULE | recursion MODULE
> def
# exit 2
# stderr
usage: narrac query [--package DIR] [--json] type-of FILE:LINE:COL | def NAME | refs NAME | callers FUNCTION | interface MODULE | recursion MODULE
> --json
# exit 2
# stderr
usage: narrac query [--package DIR] [--json] type-of FILE:LINE:COL | def NAME | refs NAME | callers FUNCTION | interface MODULE | recursion MODULE
